search_text: published ZDI-10-110 ZDI-CAN-636 Adobe Flash Player Multiple Tag JPEG Parsing Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2010-06-16 CVE-2010-2171 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2010-2171 10.0 ['Adobe'] ['Flash Player'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Adobe Flash Player. User interaction is required in that a target must visit a malicious website. The specific flaw exists within the code for parsing embedded image data within SWF files. The DefineBits tag and several of its variations are prone to a parsing issue while handling JPEG data. Specifically, the vulnerability is due to decompression routines that do not validate image dimensions sufficiently before performing operations on heap memory. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code under the context of the user running the browser. Adobe has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
